title: Hotels Near Siriraj Hospital, Bangkok 2026 — 7 Closest Stays + Booking Links | ThailandAddict
metaDesc: The 7 closest hotels to Siriraj Hospital in Bangkok — each with the real walking or driving distance to Siriraj, what it's best for, approximate starting prices and booking links. Made for patients and their families.
ogDesc: The 7 closest stays to Siriraj, with real distances and prices.
intro: Siriraj sits on the Thonburi bank of the Chao Phraya in the Wang Lang–Bangkok Noi area, so the places to stay are tucked into small lanes full of budget hostels and guesthouses rather than big chain hotels. The upside is you can walk to the wards and to Wang Lang Market easily, with food the whole way. Most rooms are small and parking is rare, but the value is hard to beat if you're staying several days to be near a patient. The list below runs cheapest to priciest.

blocks.html: Short answer: Almost everything near Siriraj sits in the Wang Lang–Prannok area on the Thonburi side — small hostels and guesthouses from a few hundred to around a thousand-plus baht, all a 5–12 minute walk to the wards. If you're with a patient's family on a budget, pick Ekanake or Icon Hostel (about 450 m away). For a pool and a hospital shuttle, go for Kaya Heritage.

blocks.text: Hotels near Siriraj, by distance & budget

items.name: Ekanake Hostel
items.meta: 📍 6-min walk (450 m) to Siriraj · ★ 2-star · Best for: Patient families · tightest budget · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A tiny hostel on Arun Amarin Road about 450 m from Siriraj, with dorm beds from 350 baht plus private rooms. Good if you're here alone to sit with a patient and want to spend as little as possible. There's a small in-house cafe, and a 7-Eleven and street stalls are a short walk away.

items.name: Icon Hostel
items.meta: 📍 6-min walk (450 m) to Siriraj · ★ 2-star · Best for: Small families · arriving by car · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: On Soi Wang Lang 8 in the Banchanglor lane, around 450 m from Siriraj, with family rooms that have private bathrooms. Its standout is free parking, which is rare around here. If you're driving and travelling as a group, it's more practical than most hostels in the area.

items.name: Wang Lang Hostel
items.meta: 📍 5-min walk (400 m) to Siriraj · ★ 2-star · Best for: Heart of Wang Lang Market · shortest walk · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: Right in the middle of the Wang Lang–Siriraj zone, a few minutes' walk to the wards and to Prannok pier. Rooms are private with air-con, a TV and an en-suite bathroom. The plus is stepping straight out into Wang Lang Market food; the trade-off is daytime crowds and no parking.

items.name: Uncle Loy's Boutique House
items.meta: 📍 9-min walk (700 m) to Siriraj · ★ 3-star · Best for: Couples · heritage-house charm · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A boutique guesthouse in an old building near Wat Rakang by the river, about a 2-minute walk to Wang Lang Market and 5 minutes to the pier, roughly 700 m to Siriraj. It scores very highly for warm hosts and a Thai-style breakfast. A good pick if you're here for a patient but want something cosier than a hostel.

items.name: Kaya Heritage Hotel
items.meta: 📍 10-min walk (700 m) · free shuttle to Siriraj · ★ 3-star · Best for: Want a pool · Siriraj shuttle · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A 65-room hotel in Bangkok Noi about 700 m from Siriraj, with an outdoor pool and an in-house cafe. What sets it apart is a free shuttle to Siriraj and to Fai Chai MRT station (limited time slots — check with the hotel). A solid choice if you want a proper hotel that's still within walking distance of the wards.

items.name: Baan Wanglang Riverside
items.meta: 📍 8-min walk (600 m) to Siriraj · ★ 3-star · Best for: River views · by the pier · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A riverside boutique hotel on Soi Wat Rakang off Prannok Road, between Siriraj and Wat Rakang piers, about 600 m from Siriraj and a 5-minute walk to Prannok pier. Rooms have air-con, a fridge and river views in some units. Couples rate it highly for the location and the views, and there's an on-site restaurant.

items.name: Theatre Residence
items.meta: 📍 10-min walk (750 m) to Siriraj · ★ 4-star · Best for: Want 4-star · quiet by Wat Rakang · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: An 85-room 4-star hotel on Soi Wat Rakang off Arun Amarin Road, converted from the former Patravadi Theatre, with an outdoor pool. It's about 750 m from Siriraj and sits in a quieter lane than Wang Lang. Reviews praise staff for help with transport. The most upmarket option in this area.

faq.q: Can you really walk to the Siriraj wards from these places?
faq.a: Yes. Most sit within 400–750 m, about a 5–12 minute walk to a hospital entrance. Hostels like Ekanake and Icon are around 450 m, while riverside hotels such as Baan Wanglang and Theatre Residence are about 600–750 m. Siriraj is a large campus, so check which building you need — walking inside can add several more minutes.

faq.q: What's the cheapest clean option near Siriraj?
faq.a: For the lowest price, a dorm bed at Ekanake Hostel starts around 350 baht per person. For a clean private room, several places run a few hundred baht — Icon Hostel and Wang Lang Hostel are roughly 550–800 baht, all with air-con and a private bathroom. Rooms fill fast when many families are visiting patients, so book ahead on Agoda or Booking.

faq.q: If I stay on the Grand Palace (Rattanakosin) side, how do I cross to Siriraj?
faq.a: Take the cross-river ferry. Tha Chang and Tha Prachan on the Rattanakosin side run ferries to Wang Lang (Siriraj) pier in about 5 minutes for roughly 4–5 baht each way, operating around 06:00–19:00. From Wang Lang pier it's a short walk into Siriraj. Handy if you'd rather stay in the old town near the Grand Palace and cross over to visit.
